title: Engine Controls — Thrust Control Quadrant Friction Damper Access and Resolver Bracket Stiffening
abstract: Rework of the thrust control quadrant to make the friction pack serviceable on wing and to stiffen the resolver bracket, ending the lever creep that crews correct by hand on long sectors.

sections.planning_reason: Crews reported thrust levers creeping back by up to two degrees over a cruise sector on aircraft above twenty thousand flight hours. It is not a safety issue but it is a persistent pilot report and it wears the friction clutch. Removed quadrants showed the friction pack bedded in beyond the adjustment range the manual allows, and in four cases the resolver mounting bracket had fretted at its attachment so that the sensed lever angle lagged the actual one by half a degree.
sections.description: The cowl latch is replaced by an access item that lets the friction pack be re-shimmed without removing the quadrant, and the shroud kit is re-profiled to clear it. The resolver bracket is stiffened and its attachment changes from two fasteners to four. The seal at the quadrant base is renewed because the base is disturbed, and a protective sleeve is added over the resolver tail.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the pedestal in accordance with the maintenance manual and isolate the thrust control installation. Remove the cowl latch VA715631-98 and install the access latch HED768198-70. Re-profile and install the shroud kit INDE893867-87. Remove the resolver bracket and install the stiffened bracket with four fasteners in place of two, using the countersunk screws LN727699-25. Install the protective sleeve LN938888K1 over the resolver tail. Renew the seal VAL944782-67 at the quadrant base. Do AMM-S-76-10-12-900-046-A to set the friction to the value in the accomplishment instructions and to confirm the resolver output against the lever angle at five positions. CAUTION: A POST-MODIFICATION QUADRANT MAY BE FITTED TO A PRE-MODIFICATION AIRCRAFT BUT NOT THE REVERSE. THE ACCESS LATCH NEEDS THE REWORKED SHROUD. Close the pedestal and do the autothrust engagement test.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to SOLANO-30, SOLANO-34 and SOLANO-39 aircraft from MSN S00097 to MSN S01380. Aircraft from MSN S01493 onward are post-modification from build. The four-engine aircraft are not covered.
sections.material_note: Kit K7610-1005-01 contains the access latch, the re-profiled shroud, the stiffened bracket, the sleeve and the seal. The friction pack is a consumable at embodiment and is supplied in the kit. Lead time is thirteen weeks. Nothing is returned.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled A-check, or at the operator's convenience.

consumables: Shim stock, stainless, 0.05 mm to 0.5 mm
